Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week (0 is Sunday), or six with seconds first. * means any, */15 every 15, 1-5 a range, 1,3,5 a list.
Examples: 0 * * * * every hour · 30 12 * * 1-5 at 12:30 on weekdays · 0 9-18 * * * every hour from 9 to 18 · */30 * * * * * every 30 seconds.
